description: Find a public API or data source for a task: use this whenever the user (or your code) needs an API, dataset or third-party service, e.g. weather, geocoding, payments, sports scores, crypto prices, jobs, LLMs. Searches 1,500+ APIs on PublicAPIs.io and returns name, description, category, link and signals (auth: none/api_key/oauth, free_tier, https). Filter with auth="none" for APIs that need no key, free=true, https=true.

auth.description: Only APIs with this authentication. "none" = no key needed.

category.description: Optional category name or id, e.g. "Weather", "finance".

free.description: Only APIs with a free tier.

query.description: What the API should do, in plain words.

name: search_apis
